title: Elf
tagline: Spaghetti with syrup. Don't knock it.
about: A human raised by Santa's elves goes to New York to find his real father.
cue: Serve the coffee when Buddy bursts into the diner to congratulate the staff.
faces: THE SEVENTH AVENUE COFFEE SHOP, NEW YORK CITY
Tossed in butter and maple syrup, chocolate sauce, marshmallows, candy.
Three buttermilk pancakes, whipped butter, a whole jug of warm syrup.
Steamed buns, yellow mustard, onions in red sauce, warm sauerkraut.
Crunchy corn set in maple butter toffee, broken into big chunks.
Salted pretzel rods in white chocolate, rolled in crushed peppermint.
A tall man in green shook every hand here Tuesday: “Great job, everybody!”
AS TAUGHT AT THE NORTH POLE
Our block in December. Smiling's his favourite, ask any cab.
Vanilla cake, thick cream cheese frosting, rolled in shredded coconut.
Thin sugar cookies, cut out and iced white, crisp at the edges.
Coffee in maple cocoa milk, whipped cream, marshmallows, candy cane.
Fresh pot on the hour, all night long.
Dear Coffee Shop, loved the coffee. I put syrup in mine.
Prices subject to change. No thrones of lies. Syrup on every table, put it on everything. Please do not hug the raccoons in the park. Santa fans 10% off. We know him! Form NP-2003.

    StartersMaple Popcorn ClustersCrunchy corn set in maple butter toffee, broken into big chunks.Syrup on every table. Put it on everything.How to make it60g popping corn1 tbsp vegetable oil200ml maple syrup40g butterPop the corn in the oil in a covered pot.Boil the maple syrup with the butter to 120°C.Pour over the popcorn, toss quickly and spread on a lined tray to set. Break into clusters.Candy Cane ForestSalted pretzel rods in white chocolate, rolled in crushed peppermint.All seven levels, one bite at a time.How to make it12 pretzel rods150g white chocolate60g crushed candy canesMelt the white chocolate in a bowl over barely simmering water.Dip each pretzel rod two-thirds into the chocolate and roll immediately in the crushed candy canes.Set on baking paper until firm.MainsTwo Griddled FranksSteamed buns, yellow mustard, onions in red sauce, warm sauerkraut.Fuel for a first walk through the big city.How to make it2 brown onions, sliced20g butter200g crushed tomatoes4 large hot dog franks200g sauerkraut4 hot dog buns4 tbsp yellow mustardSlice the onions.Cook the onions in the butter over medium-low heat until soft.Add the tomatoes and simmer.Simmer the franks in water, drain and griddle until browned. Warm the sauerkraut and steam the buns.Assemble with mustard and the tomato onions.SweetsSnowball CupcakesVanilla cake, thick cream cheese frosting, rolled in shredded coconut.Throw nothing harder than these in the park.How to make it100g butter80g caster sugar1 egg1 tsp vanilla extract100g self-raising flour40ml full cream milk100g cream cheese100g icing sugar40g shredded coconutHeat the oven to 180°C. Beat some of the butter with the sugar, add the egg and vanilla, then fold in the flour and milk.Divide between 4 large cupcake cases and bake.Cool completely.Beat the cream cheese with the remaining butter and icing sugar. Dome over the cakes and roll in the coconut.DrinksThe World's Best CupCoffee in maple cocoa milk, whipped cream, marshmallows, candy cane.Congratulations to us. Well done, team.How to make it800ml milk100g milk chocolate, chopped4 tbsp maple syrup200ml strong brewed coffee150ml thickened cream1 bag mini marshmallows2 candy canes, crushedWhip the cream.Heat the milk with the chocolate and most of the maple syrup, whisking until smooth and steaming.Stir in the coffee, or leave it out for the kids.Pour into 4 mugs and top with cream, marshmallows, a drizzle of maple syrup and crushed candy cane.
